getAnnouncements[].title: Diwali celebrations on 6 November
getAnnouncements[].body: Lunch at 1 pm on the terrace in Bengaluru and Pune. Remote colleagues: snacks are on their way.

getAnnouncements[].title: H2 self-reviews open
getAnnouncements[].body: Self-reviews for H2 2026 are open until 15 November. Managers will complete theirs by the 30th.

getAnnouncements[].title: Office Wi-Fi maintenance

sections.heading: Who this applies to
body: All employees on the Kestrel Digital payroll, including those on probation. Contract staff follow the terms in their agreement.

sections.heading: Leave types
body: Casual leave accrues at one day a month and lapses on 31 March.
Sick leave is credited as ten days each April; up to five carry forward.
Earned leave accrues at one and a half days a month after probation and can be carried forward up to thirty days.

sections.heading: Applying
body: Apply from My Space at least three working days ahead for planned leave. Sick leave can be applied for on the day.
Your reporting manager approves; leave longer than five days also goes to your department head.

sections.heading: Team thresholds
body: No more than forty percent of a delivery team may be away on the same day. Requests that cross the threshold are flagged to the approver.

sections.heading: Encashment
body: Earned leave of up to fifteen days is encashed at exit at the basic rate.

sections.heading: What can be claimed
body: Travel, meals with clients, software and hardware approved by your manager, and training approved in your goals.

sections.heading: Receipts
body: Every claim needs a receipt. GST invoices are required above ₹2,000.

sections.heading: Billable claims
body: Tag the project when an expense is rebillable. It will appear on the client’s next invoice.

sections.heading: When you are paid
body: Approved claims are reimbursed with the next weekly payout on Thursday.

sections.heading: Before day one
body: IT ships your laptop to your address on file. It arrives enrolled in device management.

sections.heading: First login
body: Sign in with your work email. You will be prompted to set up two-factor authentication.

sections.heading: Software
body: Install tools from the self-service portal. Anything not listed needs a ticket.

sections.heading: Booking
body: Book through the travel desk. Economy for flights under four hours.

sections.heading: Approvals
body: Trips over ₹25,000 need pre-approval from your department head.

sections.heading: Per-diems
body: Metro cities ₹2,500 a day; other cities ₹1,800.

sections.heading: Our commitment
body: Every employee has the right to a workplace free of harassment.

sections.heading: Internal Committee
body: The Internal Committee is chaired by Ananya Rao and includes an external member.

sections.heading: Raising a complaint
body: Complaints can be raised in writing within three months of an incident, by email or in person.

sections.heading: Inputs
body: Attendance, leave and reimbursements lock on the 25th.

sections.heading: Payment
body: Salaries are credited on the last working day of the month.
